reason: The named lab and the report for each batch is exactly what I check before I buy, and one sachet I can grab on my way out the door fixes my forgetting. At $24.99 I would try one box, at $29.99 I probably would not.
objection: $29.99 is more than Toplux or Goli, and a brand with no reviews yet has to prove the lab report is real before I trust it.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing a real batch report with the lab name I can look up, plus a few honest reviews from actual buyers.
